# Tanzania Safari Magic — AI / LLM summary

Site: https://tanzaniasafarimagic.com
Operator: Tanzania Safari Magic (Arusha, Tanzania)
Contact: +255 695 108 009 · info@tanzaniasafarimagic.com · WhatsApp available

## Primary services
- Private Tanzania safari packages (Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Tarangire, Manyara)
- Great Wildebeest Migration safaris
- Mount Kilimanjaro climbs (Machame, Lemosho, Marangu, Northern Circuit)
- Group / shared open-departure safaris
- Bush-to-beach Zanzibar extensions
- Custom itineraries from Arusha
